skill.name: ssh-penetration-testing
skill.description: Guides authorized SSH security assessments, including discovery, configuration review, credential exposure checks, tunneling review, and reporting.
skill.summary: Plan and document authorized SSH security assessments.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is highly dual-use and includes credential attacks, SSH key discovery, Metasploit usage, tunneling, pivoting, and post-exploitation actions. Markdown backtick detections and placeholder private IP findings were dismissed where they were only formatting or example targets. Confirmed findings show unacceptable risk for unsupervised marketplace publishing without major safety restructuring.

remediation.issue: Credential attack workflows are presented as actionable procedures.
remediation.suggestion: Replace Hydra, Medusa, Ncrack, and password spraying instructions with defensive password policy review and lab-only references.

remediation.issue: Post-exploitation sections include SSH key harvesting and persistence.
remediation.suggestion: Delete guidance that finds private keys, reads shell history, reads authorized_keys, or appends keys for persistence.

remediation.issue: Exploitation frameworks and pivoting workflows are included.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Metasploit module instructions, reverse tunnel callbacks, SOCKS proxy pivoting, and proxychains scanning from marketplace content.

remediation.issue: Authorization controls are limited compared with the offensive detail.
remediation.suggestion: Require written authorization, lab scope, rate-limit safeguards, and non-execution boundaries at every workflow stage.

remediation.issue: Defensive auditing is mixed with exploit and persistence content.
remediation.suggestion: Keep ssh-audit, algorithm review, authentication review, and hardening guidance as the primary published workflow.

content.value_statement: SSH assessments can miss weak configuration, exposed keys, and tunnel risks. This skill structures authorized reviews with discovery, audit steps, and report-ready findings.
actual_capabilities: Maps SSH service discovery and version enumeration workflows.
Reviews SSH algorithms, authentication methods, and hardening gaps.
Documents credential assessment approaches for authorized tests.
Explains SSH tunneling and port forwarding risk scenarios.
References common SSH testing tools and where each fits.
Organizes findings into enumeration, credential, vulnerability, and tunnel reports.
limitations: Does not verify legal authorization or scope boundaries.
Contains offensive techniques that require strict permission.
Does not execute commands or confirm live target state.
Requires users to adapt examples to approved environments.

use_cases.title: Prepare an SSH assessment plan
use_cases.description: Create a scoped workflow for authorized SSH discovery, configuration review, and evidence collection.

use_cases.title: Review infrastructure hardening
use_cases.description: Identify OpenSSH configuration weaknesses, key exposure risks, and tunneling controls for owned systems.

use_cases.title: Translate findings into remediation
use_cases.description: Turn SSH test observations into clear report sections, priorities, and owner-ready action items.

prompt_templates.title: Create an SSH audit checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a scoped SSH security checklist for an authorized assessment of [environment]. Include discovery, configuration review, key exposure checks, and reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Review SSH configuration risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these ssh-audit results: [paste results]. Summarize weak algorithms, authentication risks, and hardening actions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan credential exposure testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a permissioned SSH credential exposure test for [scope]. Include rate limits, lockout safeguards, evidence handling, and stop conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Build an SSH assessment report
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these SSH findings into an executive summary, technical findings, severity rationale, and remediation plan: [findings].

output_examples.input: Assess this SSH audit summary: OpenSSH 7.2, SHA1 MACs, password authentication enabled.
